verdict.rationale: RudderStack's own docs say it can build audiences on warehouse sources and sync or activate them in downstream tools, so the core audience-activation capability exists. Nothing shows the sync is continuous or near-real-time, or that membership entries and exits propagate incrementally. The 'near real-time' Live Events mention describes event viewing for debugging, not audience sync, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of continuous or near-real-time audience sync cadence, membership enter/exit (add/remove) handling, named ad-platform and engagement-tool audience destinations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time
